claim: The belief knowledge base at docs/kb/ - one markdown page per belief plus an index, with links following deps, reverse deps, and supersession, every link carrying a one-sentence gloss per cb:b597 - is generated from the graph by `mix cb.generate.kb` and never hand-edited; CI keeps the committed tree fresh via `mix cb.generate.kb --check`, the same freshness gate CLAUDE.md uses, so the mirror answers the cb:b386 digest antipattern with a gate rather than memory.

evidence.detail: Operator-directed build during the 2026-07-06 docs refactor session: a derived markdown mirror of the JSON beliefs forming a navigable DAG-shaped knowledge base, enabling docs to link belief references to readable pages. Design follows the CLAUDE.md precedent exactly: deterministic projection (CB.Render.Kb, pure build, byte-stable), committed output, CI-gated freshness with --check, write-mode pruning of stray pages. Golden behavior covered by test/cb/render/kb_test.exs.
